cross_domain.provenance: Complete Harbor task packages spanning all seven generated domains, authored end to end by three models and admitted by Harbor unchanged: no host assembly, no host edits. The host assigned a domain, an image catalog and a policy, then ran each model's package through real gates. Every package here passed oracle 1.0, no-op 0.0 and a fresh-instance reset-oracle 1.0 on distinct instances.
cross_domain.caveat: A technical pass is not a domain or security review, and admission proves a task is well-formed rather than difficult. None of these has had adversarial challenge controls or solver difficulty calibration run against it.
